exposure: second trimester ultrasound fetal biometrics (head circumference, abdominal circumference, femur length, estimated fetal weight)
cohort: The study included 2697 singleton pregnancies attending a second-trimester ultrasound scan at 20 + 0 to 20 + 6 weeks' gestation and giving birth at Aalborg University Hospital in 2020.
finding: Fetal biometrics above the 90th centile at the second trimester scan significantly increase the risk of Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM).
